body.p: The contextual menu of each unstaged resource contains a Show blame action. This action opens the selected resource in the main editing area and colors the editor lines based on revision information. When you select a line in the editor, the corresponding entry is highlighted in the history table in the Git History view.
The Show blame action is also available in the contextual menu of the current editor and of a Git resource selected in the Project or DITA Maps Manager view.
